capabilities: Chat with the vault via Hermes agent and slash commands like /search
Run semantic search using Hermes API or a local Ollama embedding model
Show ghost-text inline suggestions accepted with Tab
Review and approve or reject agent file changes in a diff view
Manage bibliographies, format citations, and pull text from PDFs
extras: Not yet in the official Community Plugins list; beta installs via BRAT. The README devotes a section to security and permissions: local agent bridge that spawns a subprocess, reads ~/.hermes/, and indexes the whole vault; terminal access is off by default and actions are logged to enodios/audit-log.md. MCP servers are configured in Hermes, not in this plugin.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to work with an autonomous AI agent that can search notes, suggest text inline, and edit vault files under user approval.

relations.evidence: Enodios connects your vault to a Hermes agent so you can search notes
via Hermes embeddings (API mode) or a local Ollama model
Install and enable the BRAT plugin.

requires.name: Hermes binary or remote Hermes agent

summary: AI agent bridge that connects a vault to a Hermes agent for vault chat, semantic search, inline suggestions, and agent file edits gated by diff approval.
